messages:
irene: Heads up — opened a docs PR for private installer networking + KMS/HSM notes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2453
alice: Thanks — will review later today. Quick Q: did you add the registry workaround for Docker on Windows hosts?
samir: small nit: can we call out NAT hairpin (pfSense) for customers using a management bastion? saw one customer hit that.
ben: ran the installer in a sealed env yesterday; MTU 1400 workaround needed when WireGuard is in the path. I added a systemd drop-in sample to the PR. cc @irene
irene: added MTU example in the PR:
```
[Service]
Environment="NET_MTU=1400"
```
and a note recommending validating MTU end-to-end before bootstrapping.
dev-docs-bot: Docs PR opened by irene: #2453 — reviewers requested: alice, samir.
alice: if we add HSM PKCS#11 regression note, call out SoftHSM is for testing only. also mention sysctl tweaks for large TCP transfers.
samir: agree. also add a short troubleshooting checklist: 1) DNS suffix/search order 2) MTU check 3) KMS route & ports 4) KV-cache fallback mapping.
ben: left inline suggestion to link to SDK example for KMS retries: /reference/sdk/kms-retries.md — we need to make sure the link resolves in prod build.
irene: i'll fix the link target and squash. could infra run a quick offline smoke on Windows Server 2022? @infra-sre-bot
infra-sre-bot: tagging @matt-infra for validation run.
matt-infra: i can run a quick pass this afternoon. paste the expected diagnostics commands?
irene: windows: `\.\redwood-installer.exe preflight --conn-check` and `Get-NetAdapter | Select Name, Mtu` ; linux: `./redwood-installer preflight --conn-check` . also `ping -f -l 1400 <peer>` for mtu probe.
alice: lgtm. once infra verifies i'll do final pass and merge. small copy nit: avoid the word "always" for retry semantics.
ben: :thumbsup: i'll update the systemd snippet with a comment reminding to bounce interface after mtu change.
irene: thanks all — targeting merge by EOD after matt's smoke. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2453
